description: Cancel (取消預約) a confirmed, pending or awaiting_payment booking made with request_booking, when the customer asks to. Frees the place for others and cannot be undone; a booking paid online is refunded minus the card processing fee Stripe charged and BOP's fee (5.5% + NT$10). Online cancellation closes at the business's cutoff (online_cancellation in get_business; 120 minutes before the start time unless the business sets its own cutoff).
name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
